name: Making Decisions
overview: Scripture teaches that making decisions requires trusting in the Lord’s guidance and wisdom rather than relying on our own understanding. God promises to instruct and counsel His people, guiding them in the right path as seen in Psalms 32:8 and Proverbs 2:6. Committing our ways to the Lord and seeking godly counsel ensures safety and success, while ignoring wise advice leads to folly, as emphasized in Proverbs 11:14 and 12:15. True wisdom in decision-making comes from wholehearted trust in God and submission to His direction.
